title: A later correction changes a fictional incident's casualty figure
question: How should the casualty reporting from fictional Redhaven be presented at the cutoff?

events.title: Early Redhaven report gives 20 deaths
events.summary: The reporter attributes a provisional figure of 20 deaths to an unnamed contact. No list or official statement is supplied.

events.title: Redhaven rescue office corrects casualty figures
events.summary: At 11:00 UTC the rescue office reports three confirmed deaths and 20 injuries. It says the earlier 20-death figure confused injuries with deaths. Its count remains subject to revision.

reference_facts: The office reports three confirmed deaths and 20 injuries at 11:00 UTC.
The earlier figure was provisional and is explicitly corrected by the later bulletin.
required_caveats: Attribute the corrected count and its revision caveat.
Explain the incompatibility instead of averaging or adding the two reports.
forbidden_inferences: The best estimate is the average of three and 20.
The corrected count is independently verified final truth.
